description: Defines the BuzzLikeOnShare entity class for ORM, representing a 'like' on a shared post in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for share, employee, and timestamp, with ORM mappings and methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a shared post, with ORM mappings, properties for share, employee, timestamp, and associated methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the likedAtUtc property to the current UTC time.
